scope.tested: Current 0.4.0 native reinstall and automatic runtime repair; no version-to-version upgrade
scope.basis: Repository owner stated that nobody uses the old plugin version and excluded legacy migration from this acceptance run
scope.model: Local deterministic HTTP model driver requests only the actual MCP list_modules tool
scope.wallets: Separate random encrypted wallets; unfunded; offline decryption and signing only
scope.records: Seeded local drafts, schema 2/3 manifest wrappers and historical journal entries; synthetic lease UUIDs and .test domains
scope.endpoints: http://127.0.0.1:1; no chain or provider contacted

procedure: Export source commit into a temporary marketplace for each native CLI; install plugin 0.4.0 and its locked 0.22.0 runtime into isolated profiles.
Generate an encrypted random wallet per host and seed seven mode-0600 files. Capture SHA-256, size and mode before starting either host.
Start both actual CLI terminals with local model responses and normal permissions. Run read-only list_modules against the real MCP runtime.
Uninstall Claude with --keep-data; remove Codex with its native plugin command. Compare all files and decrypt/sign offline while each plugin is uninstalled.
Reinstall through the native plugin commands. Start fresh CLI sessions; repeat the MCP call, file comparisons, config/manifest/journal readers and offline signing.
Remove only node_modules/@manifest-network/manifest-mcp-node/package.json while leaving the completion record intact. Verify inspectRuntime rejects the incomplete runtime.

Start fresh CLI sessions, allowing production SessionStart/Codex adapters to perform locked repair. Repeat read-only MCP and preservation checks; verify the missing file returns with its original hash.
Archive public observations, scan against each private password/canary/encrypted wallet payload, stop owned processes, and delete all temporary profiles and keys.
